## What this PR does



## Type
- [ ] `port:` — porting logic from upstream KillerPDF
- [ ] `feat:` — new feature
- [ ] `fix:` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor:` — no behavior change
- [ ] `test:` — adding tests only
- [ ] `docs:` / `ci:` / `chore:`

## If this is a `port:` from upstream
Link the upstream file and line range you're porting from:

> upstream `MainWindow.xaml.cs:<start>-<end>`

## Checklist
- [ ] `dotnet build` passes
- [ ] `dotnet test` passes
- [ ] `dotnet format` produces no changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased] > Fork additions`
- [ ] If `Core` got new logic, a test was added
